findings.issue: `prod_map_psum_eq_sum_smul_schurPoly` and `psumPart_eq_sum_smul_schurPoly` (line 238) omit the coefficient from the name. Every sibling expansion in this directory names it, and the bare name is the one the eventual character expansion `p_μ = ∑ χ^λ(μ) s_λ` (the roadmap target this PR cites) will want, so it is both under-descriptive and occupies the wrong slot.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Combinatorics/Young/RimHook.lean:99 `namespace YoungDiagram` (not nested in `TauCeti`), containing :181 `def rimHookRows (μ ν : YoungDiagram)`, :198 `def rimHookHeight (μ ν : YoungDiagram)`, :111 `structure IsRimHook` — the same `rimHook*` family this definition joins.

findings.issue: `TauCeti.rimHookSubdiagrams (μ : YoungDiagram) (r : ℕ)` and `TauCeti.mem_rimHookSubdiagrams` (line 95) are pure `YoungDiagram` notions whose first explicit argument is the Mathlib type `YoungDiagram`, but are declared under `namespace TauCeti`, so `μ.rimHookSubdiagrams r` does not elaborate and the declarations cannot be upstreamed without renaming.

findings.evidence: Line 128 `μ.card ≠ l.sum`; Mathlib spells out the compared value in such names, e.g. `Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero` (Mathlib/GroupTheory/Sylow.lean:783) and `normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_six` (Mathlib/GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/Alternating/Simple.lean:122).
findings.issue: `murnaghanNakayamaCoeff_eq_zero_of_card_ne` leaves the right-hand side of the hypothesis unnamed; `_of_card_ne` reads as `card ≠ 0`, while the hypothesis is `μ.card ≠ l.sum`.

summary: Two naming problems: the main theorems omit the coefficient that the directory's established pattern names (`hsymmPart_eq_sum_kostkaNumber_smul_schurPoly`), and the new `rimHookSubdiagrams`/`mem_rimHookSubdiagrams` take a `YoungDiagram` first but sit in `TauCeti` while their siblings `YoungDiagram.rimHookRows`/`rimHookHeight` are in the `YoungDiagram` namespace.
